title: notification for Dexcom transmitter expiry
symptom: Users want a notification for Dexcom transmitter expiry similar to the Dexcom receiver's four and two week warnings. One user wasted a sensor because they were not notified that the transmitter needed replacement after 3 months.
fix: The issue was addressed by adding a warning when starting a sensor close to transmitter end of life, as described in the closing comment: 'Starting a sensor, as you get close to transmitter end of life, you will get a warning that your transmitter will not work soon providing detail about when.'
evidence_quote: Starting a sensor, as you get close to transmitter end of life, you will get a warning that your transmitter will not work soon providing detail about when.
